tags.description: List the active edge servers available for running diagnostic tools.
tags.name: Edge server locations

get.description: Lists active edge server locations you can use to run [Request content with cURL](ref:post-curl), [Get domain details with dig](ref:post-dig), [Test network connectivity with MTR](ref:post-mtr), [Run the URL health check](ref:post-url-health-check), [Run the connectivity problems scenario](ref:post-connectivity-problems), and [Run the content problems scenario](ref:post-content-problems) operations. To get a subset of edge servers supporting metadata tracer, run the [List available edge server locations for metadata tracing](ref:get-mdt-locations) operation.

schema.description: Collects locations of active edge servers you can run [Request content with cURL](ref:post-curl), [Get domain details with dig](ref:post-dig), [Test network connectivity with MTR](ref:post-mtr), [Run the URL health check](ref:post-url-health-check) and [Run the connectivity problems scenario](ref:post-connectivity-problems) operations with within a top-level `edgeLocations` array.

edgeLocations.description: Lists identifiers and names of available locations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the location. Use this value for an `edgeLocationId` member in subsequent operations.

200.description: The response lists available edge server locations.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The rate limit ceiling for this endpoint.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests left for the time window.
